calls.statement:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS as_of_end),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key, params p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= p.as_of_end
)
SELECT cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS dm
FROM active a, params p
JOIN dim_member cur ON p.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
WHERE cur.member_id = a.member_id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((cur.tier), ())
ORDER BY cur.tier NULLS LAST

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, m.member_id, s.store_id, pr.category, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key=f.product_key, p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.e-364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e
)
SELECT count(*) lines, count(distinct sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(distinct member_id) members,
 count(distinct CASE WHEN store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' THEN member_id END) members_excl_test,
 count(distinct CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN member_id END) m999,
 count(distinct CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN member_id END) mzz,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f2, p WHERE f2.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f2.sale_date > p.e-364 AND f2.sale_date<=p.e) all_member_lines,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) maxdate,
 (SELECT count(distinct member_id) FROM dim_member) allmembers
FROM base

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS e),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key, p WHERE f.sale_date > p.e-364 AND f.sale_date <= p.e)
SELECT count(*) active, 
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member c, p WHERE c.member_id=a.member_id AND p.e BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to)) no_version,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member c, p WHERE c.member_id=a.member_id AND p.e BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_to)>1) multi_version,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT min(join_date) FROM dim_member c WHERE c.member_id=a.member_id) > DATE '2025-12-21') joined_after
FROM act a
